Diplodocus brings package API references and Markdown and Quarto guides together
in one documentation site. It supports Python, R, Julia, and Rust packages with
shared navigation, cross-references, and search.

You declare packages and documentation pages in a YAML configuration file. The
command-line tool validates sources, previews the site with automatic
rebuilding, and builds the site for publishing.
